title: Membership in a restricted frequency set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ and $U$ be sets of coordinates in $\\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $i\\in J$. Then $i$ belongs to the subset of $J$ consisting of coordinates that lie in $U$ if and only if the underlying coordinate of $i$ belongs to $U$.
